items.title: Air Canada claimed by TheGentlemen ransomware group
items.summary: TheGentlemen ransomware group claimed responsibility for a Sept. 9 attack on Air Canada, alleging exfiltration of 51,409 critical files with operations disrupted across Canada.

items.title: GENESIS ransomware group expands home healthcare targeting
items.summary: The GENESIS group has claimed 90-115 victims as of early September, concentrated on home healthcare providers, including a separate incident affecting an Anne Arundel County hospital.

items.title: LAPSUS$ resumes activity, teases "Chapter II" victim disclosures
items.summary: The LAPSUS$ extortion group has resumed public activity and is teasing new victim disclosures under a rebranded "Chapter II" campaign.

items.title: AUDIT TEAM extortion group hits four organizations across three countries
items.summary: The AUDIT TEAM data-extortion group conducted attacks on four organizations in South Korea, Germany, and Argentina this week.

items.title: Krybit RaaS group discloses new victims
items.summary: Krybit, an affiliate-driven ransomware-as-a-service and data-extortion operation, disclosed additional victims this week as part of its ongoing campaign.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Copilot
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on Sept. 3 knocked ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Microsoft's own Copilot offline simultaneously, pointing to a failure in shared underlying infrastructure.

outage.note: Only one clearly September-dated major cloud/SaaS outage surfaced this cycle; broader trend coverage notes AWS and GCP each had separate major regional incidents earlier in 2026.

items.title: CISA adds Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet flaws to KEV catalog
items.summary: CISA added actively exploited Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (CVSS 10.0), Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVSS 9.3), and Fortinet FortiOS flaws to its KEV catalog, with a Sept. 12 federal patch deadline.

items.title: Alipay data leaked affecting 820 million users
items.summary: A dataset containing records for roughly 820 million Alipay users was leaked online this week.

items.title: Exposed airline passenger database spans 220.8 million records
items.summary: An unsecured Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) database was found exposing 220.8 million passenger and crew records dating from 2017 to April 2026, including passport and travel-document numbers.

items.title: Mathspace breach exposes over 1 million students, staff, and parents
items.summary: Online math learning platform Mathspace disclosed that attackers stole data on more than 1 million students, staff, and parents after breaching its internal Metabase reporting system.

items.title: Veradigm discloses third-party vendor breach affecting 3.5 million patients
items.summary: Healthcare technology company Veradigm disclosed that a breach at a third-party vendor exposed roughly 3.5 million patient records, including names, addresses, SSNs, and contact details.

items.title: Aesto Health breach exposes 9.5 million people via AWS misconfiguration
items.summary: Aesto Health, a U.S. healthcare technology company, suffered a breach exposing personal and health data for more than 9.5 million people after attackers accessed its AWS infrastructure.

items.title: Super Typhoon Dolphin tracks toward Luzon, Taiwan, and southern Japan
items.summary: Super Typhoon Dolphin peaked with sustained winds over 160 mph, making it the season's most intense storm, with projected landfall across Luzon before curving toward Taiwan and southern Japan.

items.title: Lucas Fire forces evacuations on Lake-Mendocino county line, California
items.summary: The rapidly expanding Lucas Fire triggered mandatory evacuations, emergency shelter activations, and major road closures along the Lake and Mendocino county line as of Sept. 13.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake strikes off Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on Sept. 11; USGS issued a green alert with no tsunami threat.
